response.text:
Looking at the screenshots and the spec, I see these problems:

1. The homepage shows the opening-hours note ("Brez naročila težko pridete na vrsto, zato raje pokličite.") twice. It appears once in the contact-strip hours card and again in the image-text "Salon" section. That breaks "say each thing once".
2. The hero primary says "Pokličite nas", the "Salon" link says "Pokličite za termin", and the cta band says "Pokličite". The cta band repeats the call message, but it closes the page and is acceptable.
3. The services-list says "Celoten cenik najdete na strani Storitve in cenik." as its intro. That is plain navigation text, and the hero secondary and the bride link already point to the price page. This is minor, so I left it alone.
4. The "Fen frizure" row shows a price placeholder, but the client gave no price for it, so the placeholder is correct.
5. The services list says "Striženje od 10 €", which matches the child price. It is fine.

The one clear fix is the duplicated note. I'll change the salon paragraph so it says something new instead of repeating the note. The client text supports the ground floor, the parking behind the building, and the fact that the salon has "dva" workers. I'll replace the second paragraph with the colouring specialist, Petra Kos, which comes from the client's input and adds new information.
